description: Na₃BaCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.87 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.94 Å. Ba is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.66-3.13 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.32 Å) C-O bond length. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-60°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ba, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ba, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ba, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ba, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ba, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Na, two equivalent Ba, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ba, and one P atom.
